name: olympic-weightlifting-program-builder
description: Create Olympic weightlifting, powerlifting, and gym programs with two skills: build a plan without login, or use your signed-in Weightlifting Analytics account to read permitted training data and save programs through supported browser tools.

interface.longDescription: Olympic Weightlifting Program Builder helps adults plan fitness training: Olympic weightlifting, powerlifting and gym strength routines tailored to their goals, experience, equipment and weekly schedule. Build a basic program in chat without an account. Optionally use supported browser tools and your signed-in Weightlifting Analytics website account to read permitted training data and save programs. Existing account permissions apply. Programs are general fitness guidance, not medical diagnosis, treatment or rehabilitation. The plugin does not provide browser tools or a native OAuth/MCP connection. Program import links are offered only when the host can generate and verify them. Support through donations is voluntary.
defaultPrompt: Build a beginner Olympic weightlifting program.
Plan four weeks of gym strength training.

publication.release_notes: Removed subscription references from the listing description and clarified that donations are voluntary. Retains the corrected package name, Healthcare category and iOS icons for light and dark themes. Includes two skills: build Olympic weightlifting, powerlifting and gym programs without an account, or use supported browser tools and existing website permissions to save programs. Includes the iOS app icon and public support, privacy and terms pages. Optional program links require verification of website availability before use.
